# Reverend Ez

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c24 P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003), [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** theology student and minister  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Ezra Hale  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>; Ez  <sub>[v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Ezra is considered an exceptionally unattractive young man with a large, gangly frame and elongated legs. He has flaxen, limp hair, green eyes, a large mouth, and notable ears, along with a scholarly forehead usually covered by unkempt hair. When preaching, his impassioned eyes give him a different presence, and he possesses a delightful voice that makes him sound charming.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)_

## Personality

Ezra is serious, gentle, faithful, and dedicated to his calling as a clergyman. He is also lighthearted and fun-loving in social settings, enjoying jokes and laughter, which leads some older women to disapprove of him. He is affectionate, understanding, and accepts loved ones for who they truly are.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)_

## Goals

- to fulfill the labor assigned to him as a clergyman with God's assistance  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>

## History

Ezra graduated from Wexcombe College and pursued theology at St. Columbia after initially resisting a calling to the ministry. Over a summer, he took charge of the Point Prospect Mission Church, living as one of the roomers at Cousin Emily's boarding house. During this time, he formed a close friendship with Cressy Lindsay through shared outings like fishing, boating, and walking along the shore. Although he hesitated to ask for Cressy's hand in marriage due to his lack of wealth, their mutual affection led to an engagement, with plans to wed in June. After initial resistance from Cressy's mother, Ezra visited her parents at Mount Holly, where both of her parents grew to adore him.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003), [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c26 P11](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0011), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021), [v3 c29 P6](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0006), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010)_
